object.attr: derived: a figure from another clone can make the figure program load a local image into an issued PDF, or reach a share and send the user's credentials (CF-P49; D-P19). MELLON-STORE-SRS-231 forbids the read; this is the export's response. The test cases cover MELLON-STORE-SRS-231 for drawn figures (STORE hand-off).
object.description: If drawing a figure needs a file or network resource outside the figure file, the exported PDF shall show a figure placeholder in place of the figure.
